title: REPL overhaul for v1.5 spec
description:
Ground-up REPL rewrite per ai_terminal_spec_v1.5: drop Rich panel wrapper, drive single-line status indicator, and render narration as plain text with optional fenced blocks only; placeholders map to inline text for scalars and fenced blocks for structured outputs. Implementation plan:
1. Replace current render_cycle/Main loop so each cycle prints user query + final response without nested panels; keep Cycle ID bottom-right as plain text.
2. Rebuild narration composer to walk response_segments, treating placeholders according to output_value_types (text vs. block) and only pulling stdout metadata when a block needs it.
3. Implement block helpers for plan/bash/output/json/md/log and ensure ANSI formatting stays inside fences.
4. Add snapshot-style tests for renderer output and rerun orchestrator/formatter suites.
